- manual_AR-210.md, manual_AR-220.md, manual_AR-310.md, manual_AR-320.md  
- manual_BZ-110.md, manual_BZ-120.md, manual_BZ-210.md, manual_BZ-220.md  
- procedure_SP-108.md  
- report_R-2025-005.md, report_R-2025-008.md, report_R-2025-014.md, report_R-2025-016.md, report_R-2025-017.md, report_R-2025-020.md, report_R-2025-021.md, report_R-2025-038.md  

Финальная деталь цепочки замен: **SP-108**.
